title: See-through Glitter Cap Sleeve A-Line Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant midi dress pairs a softly pleated skirt with a beautifully beaded sequin bodice for a refined, feminine look. The sheer neckline and cap sleeves frame the shoulders and upper body with a light, graceful feel, while the defined waist creates a flattering shape. A lovely choice for wedding guest looks and other special occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
